rules.statement: Proper rights of way must be provided from within the property for access to a public right of way during partitioning.
rules.supporting_quote: 1. In the process of partitioning, proper rights of way should be provided from within the corpus as access to a public right of way. 2. The road claimed by the petitioners was not a via vicinalis. There was no proof of immemorial user of the disputed roadway or prescription. 204. 3. There was fundamental error in confirming the scheme of partition without affording the petitioners an opportunity to object to it. 4.
